answer: Make every agent identity renew itself each epoch by solving a memory-hard puzzle, Argon2-style, that needs about 4 GB of RAM for ten minutes. Memory can't be shared between parallel solves, so a forge of 1,000 clones must keep 4 TB of RAM busy every epoch instead of one cheap server. An honest agent pays a small, steady cost; the attacker's bill grows linearly with each fake, and a clone that skips a renewal sees its reputation spiral down to zero. A velvet glove for one agent, a heavy toll for a farm.
